newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER - PETULANT BOGARDE LEFT OUT OF AJAX SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - PETULANT BOGARDE LEFT OUT OF AJAX SQUAD.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam coach Louis van Gaal took defender Winston Bogarde out of the squad for Wednesday's Champions league match against Atletico Madrid because the player refused to accept a place on the bench, Dutch news agency ANP said on Monday.
Van Gaal expressed doubts that Bogarde would return to the squad this season, while the Ajax board was said to considering sacking the player, ANP said.
Bogarde, who had not been playing for months due to injury, said he was fully fit for Wednesday's match.
Last month, he signed a four-year contract to play for AC Milan, starting next season.
